title: Eventual exactness at shifted kernel quotient terms
statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_quotient_transition_exact_bound
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H)
    (c : ℕ) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj)
    (hc : ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l),
      Subobject.mk
          (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) =
        Subobject.mk
          (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op)))
    (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅
      Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op),
      e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m)) :
    ∃ b : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, max c b ≤ d → ∀ n : ℕ,
      ∃ hz : Scheme.idealModuleProductι
          (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (n + 1)).2
          ((formalShiftedQuotient I S d).obj (op (n + 1))) ≫
          (formalShiftedQuotient I S d).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op = 0,
        (ShortComplex.mk
          (Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower I.toModulesι (n + 1)).2
            ((formalShiftedQuotient I S d).obj (op (n + 1))))
          ((formalShiftedQuotient I S d).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) hz).Exact

proof.text: Use the shifted stalk quotient model and its uniform bound. The ideal product of the target level is zero because that level is its defining quotient; multiplication naturality and epimorphy of tensoring a quotient projection prove this directly. FormalModuleQuotient_factor then proves the required zero composite for every shift.

Use exactness detection on stalks. The ideal-product stalk formula identifies the range of the first map with J^(n+1) times the source stalk. The compatible quotient model carries an element killed by the transition to an element killed by M/J^(n+2)M -> M/J^(n+1)M. Prove directly with quotient representatives and Submodule.map_smul'' that this kernel is J^(n+1) times its source. Pull back membership along the linear equivalence using Submodule.comap_smul_top_of_surjective. Membership in the range supplies the needed stalk preimage, so the stalk complex and hence the sheaf complex is exact.
